name: The Corrupter
summary: Takata Steelblade sides with Maurin: Lord Azrethoc must be stopped, especially if he seeks influence over the Burning Blade. Takata trusts you to gather a party against the demon lord and his warlock servant, Jugkar Grim'rod.

sections.title: A Party to the South
sections.body: Takata has never heard of Lord Azrethoc, but agrees with Maurin that the demon lord must be stopped. The danger grows if Azrethoc is trying to sway the Burning Blade. You have already shown that you want to aid the Warchief, so Takata trusts you to gather a party and slay Azrethoc and his warlock servant, Jugkar Grim'rod. Head directly south to Mannoroc Coven, where both are found.

sections.title: Takata's Worry
sections.body: Takata calls the demons in Desolace a greater threat than ever. Each newly arrived foul creature dims the prospect of returning to the Warchief. At times, Takata wishes the centaur were the only enemy.

sections.title: Takata's Verdict
sections.body: Once the threat is ended, Takata calls it a mighty victory for all. The outlook here is less bleak than Takata once feared. The demons are slain, the Burning Blade has failed in its efforts, and a place to call home is safe again.

faq.q: Who is sending adventurers against Lord Azrethoc?
faq.answer: Takata Steelblade sides with Maurin and trusts you to gather a party against the demon lord.
Lord Azrethoc, a demon lord, and Jugkar Grim'rod, his warlock servant, must be defeated.
Takata says to head directly south to Mannoroc Coven in southern Desolace, where both are found.

faq.q: Why does Lord Azrethoc pose such a danger?
faq.answer: Takata has never heard of Azrethoc, but agrees that the demon lord must be stopped, especially if he is trying to sway the Burning Blade.

faq.q: What comes before this in the chain?
faq.answer: This step follows the fourth part of The Corrupter chain.

faq.q: What does Takata fear about the demons in Desolace?
faq.answer: Takata calls the demons a greater threat than ever. Each newly arrived foul creature dims the prospect of returning to the Warchief, and Takata sometimes wishes the centaur were the only enemy.
